summary: The proposed change introduces a new method `set_paths` in `ContourSet`, which is a non-minimal change and may introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The change adds a new method `set_paths` in `ContourSet`, which is not minimal as it duplicates functionality already present in `collections.py`. This could lead to confusion and maintenance overhead.

The change may introduce behavioral regressions as it modifies the behavior of `ContourSet` without thorough testing of existing use cases, especially those involving transformations and contour labeling.
